stories.title: Sources: Falcons RB Robinson gets record deal
stories.summary: Bijan Robinson and the Atlanta Falcons reached agreement on a three-year extension worth up to $75 million that will make him the highest-paid running back in NFL history, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter and NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

stories.title: Flowers, Ravens reach 4-year, $140M extension
stories.summary: Two-time Pro Bowl receiver Zay Flowers has agreed with the Ravens on a four-year, $140M extension that includes $108 million guaranteed, his agency told ESPN.

stories.title: Bookie: Ohtani ex-interpreter's betting 'bananas'
stories.summary: The bookie for Ippei Mizuhara told ESPN that Shohei Ohtani's former interpreter showed signs of problem gambling within 30 days of betting with him.
